GAN Tarlac Speedcubing Open 2026 is the second ever competition held here in Tarlac! Marking its return to the speedcubing community of Central Luzon. Continuing it’s legacy from the Luisita Speedcubing Open 2018 which took place almost a decade ago, making a Fresh start in 2026!

The competition is officially sponsored and held in partnership with GANCUBE, one of the leading brands in speedcubing innovation, whose support helps elevate the overall competition experience for all participants.
